info.title: Chargeblast Universal API
info.description: Chargeblast helps merchants prevent chargebacks through alerts, digital receipts, deflections, merchant enrollment, and related API-driven dispute-prevention workflows.

page.description: The current page index returned by Chargeblast.

per.description: The number of alerts returned per page.
